description_sq:
Shitet apartament tek Qndra Kristal ,Komuna Parisit.
Apartamenti ka sipërfaqe totale 113.3 m2, sipërfaqe neto 85.7 m2 dhe verandë me sipërfaqe 19.7 m2. 
Ndodhet në katin 3 banim, me ashensor. Ndertese e vitit 2007.
 Orientimi është lindje-perëndim, duke siguruar ndriçim natyral gjatë gjithë ditës.
 Perbehet nga dy dhoma gjumi, dy tualete, ambient ndenjeje të përbashkët me kuzhinën, ballkon, verandë, një depo dhe korridor shpërndarës.
Lartesia e apartamentit eshte afersisht 3 metra. 
Apartamenti shitet pjesërisht i mobiluar.
Aktualisht eshte i dhene me qira duke e bere nje investim edhe me te sigurte.
title_en: APARTMENT FOR SALE 2+1+2+VERANDE IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF PARIS
description_en: Apartment for sale in Kristal Center, Paris Municipality. The apartment has a total area of ​​113.3 m2, a net area of ​​85.7 m2 and a veranda with an area of ​​19.7 m2. It is located on the 3rd residential floor, with an elevator. Built in 2007. Orientation is east-west, providing natural lighting throughout the day. It consists of two bedrooms, two bathrooms, living room shared with the kitchen, balcony, veranda, a storage room and distribution corridor. The height of the apartment is approximately 3 meters. The apartment is sold partially furnished. It is currently rented out, making it an even safer investment.
